reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: CA Women in Business II - ICB Loan II (EFSD+1)

description.narrative: The provision of a senior unsecured loan of up to US$ 5.0m (in TJS equivalent) to ICB under the Financial Intermediary Framework-Central Asian Women in Business II (CA WiB II ) programme for on-lending to women-led MSMEs. The proposed loan is the third WiB loan to the client following the successful realisation of a first pilot under the Taj WiB programme and a first transaction under the CA WiB. The transaction represents a continuation of the previous engagements, aiming to further support women-led MSMEs in Tajikistan by providing financing opportunities for their business activities and access to know-how.
